These fixtures are handcrafted synthetic data. The `*_002.json` files and seven
native-format files are byte-exact copies of the frozen195 contract oracles.
`fixture_support.py` also constructs small synthetic FASTQ/SAM/report bundles.
They are not genuine retained service results, live BV-BRC execution, or proof
of authenticated host custody. Tests use actual native reader and calculator
implementations except the explicit saved-read prohibition checks.
